decision: PHASE-0-DECISIONS D-001: the navigational accent is authored, not measured. Candidates must pass ACCENT_CONTRAST (tools/assets/accent.mjs); the H2.5 feel test picks one. Until then `default` is what ships, and ?accent=<name> switches the torii in place.

area.rule: ACCENT_AREA (D-003, revised by D-006): a FLOOR at scanning distance, no ceiling. Each kit_torii, in route order, is scanned for from the previous anchor (previous torii, else spawn) with the follow rig at rest facing it; its accent must cover >= floor_pct of the frame. Harness `accent` stage.
area.floor_basis: PROVISIONAL until H2.5. Measured 2026-11-08 (tools/harness/accent-floor.ts -> docs/build-log/accent/palette/curve.json): the last distance (90 m before the gate) at which the largest connected accent blob still exceeds 27.6 px — the seed red's observed failure area, 0.012% of a 640x360 frame. At 100 m it fractures to 18 px. Frozen as a number so a smaller gate fails it rather than moving it.
